block.bathhouse.inner_heater.tooltip: Goes inside the steam room. Feed it wood or coal (right-click), throw water on the stones with a ladle. Without a chimney on top it smokes into the room.
block.bathhouse.outer_heater.tooltip: Built into the wall with the firebox door facing out: fire and smoke stay in the changing room, stones face the steam room.
block.bathhouse.brick_stove.tooltip: Massive stove with a closed stone chamber: slow to heat, holds heat for long.
block.bathhouse.iron_stove.tooltip: Heats fast and hard and dries the air. No stones, so no steam.
block.bathhouse.electric_heater.tooltip: Runs on redstone (power follows signal strength). Smokeless. Has stones for steam.
block.bathhouse.steam_generator.tooltip: Fill with water by bucket or pipe and give it a redstone signal. Makes steam: the heart of a mist hall.
block.bathhouse.warm_lounger.tooltip: Heated marble (redstone). In a mist hall, sessions go twice as fast while you rest on it.
block.bathhouse.bath_gauge.tooltip: Hang it on the wall of a closed steam room: it decides what kind of bath it is and grants the buffs.
block.bathhouse.bath_gauge.tooltip2: Right-click for a full report. Comparators read the temperature.
block.bathhouse.chimney.tooltip: Right on a stove: the bath is heated white. In the steam room ceiling, for a stove without its own flue: gray.
block.bathhouse.smoke_vent.tooltip: Right-click to open or close. Open, it lets out smoke, steam and some heat.
block.bathhouse.cold_plunge.tooltip: 4–12 °C water for the contrast dip after the steam room: 10–30 s. Chill it with ice or snow.
block.bathhouse.hot_plunge.tooltip: Wood-fired hot water. Keep the water no higher than the chest (level 2 of 3), and don't stay too long.
block.bathhouse.sawdust_plunge.tooltip: Wood-fired hot cedar and linden shavings. Flowers add herbs that make the buff last longer.
item.bathhouse.ladle.tooltip: Scoop water from a source or cauldron; right-click a heater to throw it on the stones. Also scoops water out of plunges.
item.bathhouse.bath_broom.tooltip: Whisking in a steam lodge speeds up the session and heals. In the dry heat of an ember room it dries out and scalds.
item.bathhouse.bath_broom.not_here: Use the broom in a ready steam lodge
item.bathhouse.bath_broom.forbidden: The broom crumbled in the dry heat and scalded your skin!
item.bathhouse.scrub_mitt.tooltip: Scrubbing in a mist hall speeds up the session and heals.
item.bathhouse.scrub_mitt.not_here: Use the mitt in a ready mist hall
bathhouse.variant.white.hint: every firebox has its own chimney, walls stay clean
bathhouse.variant.gray.hint: smoke passes through the room into a flue in the ceiling; heats fast
bathhouse.variant.black.hint: smoke leaves only through the door and smoke window; steam after the fire is out and the room is aired
bathhouse.equipment.fired_stone_heater: wood-fired stove with stones (inner or outer-fed heater, brick stove)
bathhouse.equipment.stone_heater: stove with stones (any heater or brick stove)
bathhouse.problem.duplicate: This steam room already has another thermo-hygrometer
bathhouse.problem.leaky: The room is not closed (open door, trapdoor or gate) or holds more than %s blocks of air
bathhouse.problem.too_small: Too cramped: %s m³, needs at least %s m³
bathhouse.problem.smoke: Smoke %s%%: a bath heated %s needs %s%% or less; let the fire burn out and air the room
bathhouse.appliance.stones_cold: The stones are cold (%s °C); the water just runs off
bathhouse.report.no_room: No closed steam room: shut the doors and trapdoors; it may hold at most %s blocks of air.
bathhouse.report.no_appliances: No stove or appliance borders the steam room
bathhouse.report.stay: Stay in the steam room for %s s to receive the buff
bathhouse.plunge.herbs_added: Herbs steeped: the buff will last longer
bathhouse.plunge.cold_shock: Cold shock! Only take the cold plunge after a steam lodge or ember room.
bathhouse.plunge.abrupt: Abrupt plunge! Don't run and jump into the tub.
bathhouse.plunge.chilled: Too long in icy water: you're getting chilled!
bathhouse.plunge.overload: Your heart is overloaded: time to get out!
bathhouse.plunge.too_deep_water: Water above the chest: scoop it down to level 2 with a ladle
bathhouse.plunge.too_deep_sawdust: Shavings above the chest: rake some out (sneak + right-click)
bathhouse.plunge.ducking: Don't duck under: sit up straight
bathhouse.plunge.too_hot: too hot; wait or add ice
bathhouse.plunge.contrast.not_warm: No contrast without warming up in the steam room first.
bathhouse.plunge.contrast.too_short: A %s s dip is too short for contrast.
death.attack.bathhouse.overheat.player: %1$s overheated in the bathhouse while fleeing %2$s
